additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Titan-Snapper can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Siege Monster
additionalAbilities.description: The Titan-Snapper deals double damage to objects and structures.

additionalAbilities.name: Murk Dweller
additionalAbilities.description: While submerged in murky water, the Titan-Snapper can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

additionalAbilities.name: Unstoppable
additionalAbilities.description: The Titan-Snapper has advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone, pushed, or grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Titan-Snapper makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Crushing Tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10+6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Titan-Snapper can't bite another target.

actions.name: Crushing Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10+6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The Titan-Snapper makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the Titan-Snapper, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the Titan-Snapper's turns. If the Titan-Snapper takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the Titan-Snapper must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the Titan-Snapper. If the Titan-Snapper dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Dreadful Bellow (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The Titan-Snapper emits a terrifying roar. Each creature of its choice within 60 feet of it that can hear it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Legendary Endurance
legendaryActions.description: If the Titan-Snapper fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

flavor.description: A bulbous, fast-flying mid-boss darkling ooze known as the Darkforme Nightsipper. It regenerates by drinking from foes and unleashes a terrifying brown-note screech that incapacitates and instills fear.

additionalAbilities.name: Life Drain (Regeneration)
additionalAbilities.description: Whenever the Nightsipper successfully hits a creature with its Siphoning Bite, it regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

additionalAbilities.name: Engulf
additionalAbilities.description: The Nightsipper can attempt to engulf one creature of Medium size or smaller within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be swallowed. While swallowed, the creature is restrained and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of its turn. A swallowed creature can escape by making a successful DC 15 Strength check to burst from the Nightsipper’s belly, dealing 6 (1d6) piercing damage to the Nightsipper, or by succeeding on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw at the start of its turn to wriggle free and be ejected prone into an unoccupied space within 5 feet.

additionalAbilities.name: Brown-Note Screech
additionalAbilities.description: As an action, the Nightsipper releases a horrifying, discordant screech in a 30-foot radius. Creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become incapacitated until the end of their next turn. Then, they must immediately roll a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw at disadvantage; on a failure, the creature becomes frightened for 1 minute (it can repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn to end the effect).

actions.name: Siphoning Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage plus 6 (1d10) acid damage.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The rift can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The rift regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Planar Instability
additionalAbilities.description: The rift cannot be attacked or harmed by conventional means. Spells like dispel magic or remove curse cast at 6th level or higher can damage it. Closing the rift requires succeeding on three DC 18 Intelligence (Arcana) checks as an action while within 5 feet of it. Each failed check deals 11 (2d10) psychic damage to the checker.

additionalAbilities.name: Summoning Sickness
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of each of its turns, the rift summons 1d4 Darkling monsters or 1 Diaper-themed construct. Roll a d6: 1-2 (Darkling-Lurkers), 3-4 (Deranged Diaper-Check Bots), 5 (Darkforme Overwatch), 6 (Pacifier Golem). Summoned creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the rift and act on their own initiative.

actions.name: Planar Energy
actions.description: The rift hums with otherworldly energy but takes no direct action.

legendaryActions.name: Unravel Reality
legendaryActions.description: The rift targets one creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or take 16 (3d10) psychic damage and suffer a random effect from the Wild Magic Tantrum table.

legendaryActions.name: Dimensional Reach
legendaryActions.description: The rift attempts to pull one creature it can see within 120 feet into its dimension. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be pulled into a harmless demiplane. At the end of its next turn, the target reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space.

legendaryActions.name: Chaotic Surge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The rift releases a wave of energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the rift must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be affected by the Big Babification spell for 1 minute.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Stalker
additionalAbilities.description: While in dim light or darkness, the Darkling Pack Alpha has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can Hide as a bonus action.

additionalAbilities.name: Pounce
additionalAbilities.description: If the Darkling Pack Alpha moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the Pack Alpha can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The Darkling Pack Alpha has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the Pack Alpha’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Ambush (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Darkling Pack Alpha teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness that it can see. It can make a claw attack immediately after teleporting.

additionalAbilities.name: Aquatic Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Pike-Maw has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Breathing
additionalAbilities.description: The Pike-Maw can breathe only underwater.

additionalAbilities.name: Darting Attack
additionalAbilities.description: If the Pike-Maw moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Bite attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pulled 5 feet toward the Pike-Maw.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: This Weirdling-Paralurker has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and isn’t incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Unsettling Reconfiguration
additionalAbilities.description: When reduced to 0 HP (but not less than -9 HP), the Weirdling transforms back into a Darkling-Paralurker. Any creature within 25 ft. that witnesses this transformation must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer a "brown note incident," losing their reactions until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Talon Kick
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The field can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The field regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Anchor
additionalAbilities.description: The field is immune to effects that would move it or alter time within its space.

additionalAbilities.name: Regression Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the field must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by a magical regression. The creature's age is reduced by 1d4 x 2 years for 1 hour. If this reduces a creature's age below its age of maturity, it is affected as if by the Babybrain spell for the duration. The effect can be ended by remove curse or similar magic.

actions.name: Energy Pulse
actions.description: The field emits a low hum but takes no direct action.

legendaryActions.name: Focused Regression
legendaryActions.description: The field targets one creature within 60 feet. The target must repeat the saving throw against the Regression Aura.

legendaryActions.name: Mental Assault
legendaryActions.description: The field targets one creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Drain Vitality (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 60 feet of the field must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The field regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

flavor.description: Huge abomination—a living ossuary formed by countless ossuite remains fused into a massive, lumbering bone monster. It shuffles slowly along the floor, exuding a pants‐crapping fear presence. Its hideous body carries brutal melee attacks reminiscent of lesser ossuite kin, and it wields an array of dark, divine spells that combine arcane and clerical power. Once per day, it can teleport to a new space, forcing all in its wake to contend with a crushing, pinning avalanche of bones.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The darkforme-ossuarian can take the Legendary Action listed below once per day, recharging at Midnight.

additionalAbilities.name: Pants-Crapping Fear Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature within 30 ft. that can see the Darkforme-Ossuarian must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute- as well as hypermess or hyperwet their current smallclothes.

additionalAbilities.name: Living Ossuary Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description:
The Darkforme-Ossuarian is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spells). It has the following spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): Toll the Dead, Spare the Dying
• 1st level (4 slots): Inflict Wounds, Guiding Bolt
• 2nd level (3 slots): Spiritual Weapon, Hold Person, Blindness/Deafness
• 3rd level (2 slots): Animate Dead, Blight, Bestow Curse
These spells—many rendered with a divine twist—augment its already deadly melee prowess.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Darkforme-Ossuarian makes two Bone Slam attacks and one Bone Rake attack.

actions.name: Bone Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bone Rake
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, the target suffers 1d8+5 slashing damage and, if already grappled by the ossuarian, becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Bone Crush Teleport
legendaryActions.description: Once per day, the Darkforme-Ossuarian can teleport to any space it can see. Any creature occupying that space must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d10 crushing damage and become pinned. A pinned creature can attempt to break free at the end of each of its turns by succeeding on a Strength (Athletics) or Escape Artist check (DC 15).

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Gloom-Newt can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Slippery Hide
additionalAbilities.description: The Gloom-Newt has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

additionalAbilities.name: Disorienting Slime
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that touches the Gloom-Newt or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+1) bludgeoning damage.

flavor.description: Medium abomination, frail and insatiably hungry

additionalAbilities.name: Partial-Swallow
additionalAbilities.description: When the Darkling-Hungerer successfully grapples a creature, that creature is partially swallowed. At the start of each of the Hungerer's turns, the swallowed creature takes 1d6 crushing damage. The grappled creature can attempt to escape as an action by making a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (DC 12).

actions.name: Gnawing Swipe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On hit, the target takes 4 (1d4+1) bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or be grappled (thus triggering Partial-Swallow).

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Darkling Rill-Skitter can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Murky Ambush
additionalAbilities.description: If the Darkling Rill-Skitter is in murky water or otherwise lightly obscured, it can use a bonus action to Hide. It has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

actions.name: Nipping Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

flavor.description: Large abomination, a menacing mid-boss with a voracious maw

additionalAbilities.name: Large Build
additionalAbilities.description: The Darkforme-Hungore counts as one size larger when grappling opponents.

additionalAbilities.name: Ventral Maw
additionalAbilities.description: When the Darkforme-Hungore hits a creature with its Ventral Maw attack, it grapples the target and attempts to swallow it. A grappled target is partially restrained and, while swallowed, takes 2d6 compressive asphyxiative damage at the start of each of the Hungore's turns. The swallowed creature can attempt to escape by making a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (DC 14) as an action. If the creature fails to escape within 10 rounds, it dies.

actions.name: Ventral Maw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On hit, the target takes 10 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage and is grappled (swallowed) by the Darkforme-Hungore, triggering the Ventral Maw effect.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Blood-Gorger can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Spider Climb
additionalAbilities.description: The Blood-Gorger can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Stealth
additionalAbilities.description: While in water, the Blood-Gorger has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

actions.name: Drain Blood
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, and the Blood-Gorger attaches to the target. While attached, the Blood-Gorger doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the Blood-Gorger's turns, the target loses 5 (1d6 + 2) hit points due to blood loss, and the Blood-Gorger regains hit points equal to the amount of hit points the target lost. The Blood-Gorger can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the Blood-Gorger with a successful DC 11 Strength check.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Matronbot can take up to 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature’s turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Commanding Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Allied nannybots within 30 feet of the Matronbot gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws while they can see or hear her.

additionalAbilities.name: Reinforcement Deployment
additionalAbilities.description:
As a bonus action, the Matronbot can use her integrated summoning core to call reinforcements. Roll a d6: 
- On a 4–6, 1d4 Diaper-check Bots arrive within 2 rounds. 
- On a 6, a single **Dark Dimension Bratnapper** joins the fray instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Matronbot makes two attacks: one with her **Diaper Grappler** and one with her **Punishment Rod**.

actions.name: Diaper Grappler
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 
Hit: 10 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained in sticky energy restraints until the end of the Matronbot’s next turn.

actions.name: Punishment Rod
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 12 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is restrained, this attack deals an additional 1d6 psychic damage as the Matronbot enforces "discipline."

actions.name: Sonic Command
actions.description: The Matronbot emits a deafening, authoritative pulse in a 20-foot radius. Each enemy creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) thunder damage and be stunned until the end of their next turn. Allied nannybots in the radius instead gain temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + the Matronbot’s Charisma modifier.

legendaryActions.name: Issue Command
legendaryActions.description: An allied nannybot within 30 feet can immediately make one weapon attack or move up to its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Overclock
legendaryActions.description: The Matronbot increases her speed by 20 feet until the end of her next turn and gains +2 to her AC during this time.

legendaryActions.name: Reinforce Discipline
legendaryActions.description: The Matronbot recharges her **Reinforcement Deployment** ability immediately, even if it was expended.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
additionalAbilities.description: The lullaby can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

additionalAbilities.name: Aura of Dread
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the lullaby must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Draining Melody
actions.description: The lullaby hums a dissonant tune. Each creature of the lullaby's choice within 60 feet that can hear it must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failure, a creature is also overcome with sorrow and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Sleep of Terrors (1/Day)
actions.description: The lullaby sings a haunting song. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes. An unconscious creature is plagued by nightmares and takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. The effect ends for a creature if it takes any damage from another source or if someone uses an action to shake it awake.

additionalAbilities.name: Babysitter
additionalAbilities.description: This creature gains advantage on any check that involves identifying or tracking a diapered character or a character whose pants or underpants are wet/stained. At the start of combat for this creature, it will initiate an investigation check to identify babies in need of sitting.

additionalAbilities.name: Ancient Alert
additionalAbilities.description: After having identified butts in need of diapering, the Diaper-Check bot will make a DC 15 Performance Check. On a success, the diaper-check bot will summon 1d2 Diaper-check Bots if any are nearby.

actions.name: Spank and Diaper
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) On hit, the target must roll a DC 13 Dexterity Save or be Diapered if not already diapered. The diaper is decided by rolling on the diaper chart. If the target is diapered and the diaper is in need of using, the robot will attempt to grapple and change the opponent the following turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Each creature of the abomination's choice that is within 120 feet of the abomination and aware of it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

additionalAbilities.name: Spill Stuffing
additionalAbilities.description: When the abomination takes 15 or more slashing or piercing damage from a single attack, its stuffing spills out, creating an area of difficult terrain in a 10-foot radius around it that lasts for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abomination makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The Current-Drifter can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Current-Drifter has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

additionalAbilities.name: Shocking Aura
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that touches the Current-Drifter or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Constricting Shock
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Lightning Pulse (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Current-Drifter emits a pulse of electrical energy. Each creature within 15 feet of it in the water must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

additionalAbilities.name: Diabolical Babysitter
additionalAbilities.description: The Bratnapper has advantage on checks to grapple creatures under 5 feet tall or creatures wearing diapers. Its sensors are fine-tuned to detect "unruly behavior," as deemed by its corrupted core programming.

additionalAbilities.name: Snatch-and-Grab
additionalAbilities.description: If the Bratnapper successfully grapples a creature, it can use its bonus action to attempt to “Bratnap” the target. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained as the Bratnapper wraps its dark energy restraints around them.

actions.name: Bratnap Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage. On a hit, the target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On failure, their gear or outfit becomes entangled, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity checks until the target uses an action to untangle it.

actions.name: Temporal Timeout
actions.description: The Bratnapper targets one creature within 30 ft. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be magically paralyzed for 1 round, as if frozen in a moment of "naughty behavior."

actions.name: Reinforcement Call
actions.description: The Bratnapper uses its corrupted programming to call for reinforcements. Roll a d6; on a 5 or 6, 1d2 Diaper-check Bots or another Dark Dimension Nannybot arrive within 2 rounds.

flavor.description: Medium abomination, a stealthy aquatic predator with a predatory grin

additionalAbilities.name: Aquatic Ambush
additionalAbilities.description: The Darkling-Shark has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are surprised while in water or emerging from it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+2 piercing damage.

flavor.description: Large abomination, a twisted aquatic predator with crab legs and an unsettling presence

additionalAbilities.name: Unsettling Presence
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature within 25 ft. that witnesses the Darkforme-Shark's sudden transition from aquatic to terrestrial posture (as its crab legs engage) must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer a 'brown note incident,' losing their reactions until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Ravenous Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+4 piercing damage.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The crying starmass can take 0 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The crying starmass regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Gravity Well
additionalAbilities.description: The area in a 30-foot radius around the starmass is difficult terrain. Any creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet toward the starmass.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The starmass makes two Comet Slam attacks.

actions.name: Comet Slam
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) force damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Sorrowful Wail (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The starmass unleashes a psychic cry. Each creature within 60 feet must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (5d10) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and is not stunned.

additionalAbilities.name: Magic Resistance
additionalAbilities.description: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

additionalAbilities.name: Time-Locked
additionalAbilities.description: The guardian is immune to any effect that would alter the flow of time for it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guardian makes two Chronal Slam attacks.

actions.name: Chronal Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have its speed halved until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Temporal Rewind (1/Day)
actions.description: When the guardian or a creature it can see within 60 feet takes damage, the guardian can use its reaction to rewind time to just before the damage was dealt. The damage is negated.

reactions.name: Causal Rejection
reactions.description: When a creature the guardian can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, the guardian can force the creature to reroll the d20. The creature must use the second roll.

additionalAbilities.name: Ethereal Jaunt
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the dream stealer can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

additionalAbilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description:
The dream stealer's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect thoughts, sleep
3/day each: phantasmal force, suggestion
1/day each: dream, modify memory

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dream stealer makes two Nightmare Touch attacks.

actions.name: Nightmare Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Steal Dream (1/Day)
actions.description: The dream stealer targets one unconscious creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or the dream stealer steals a cherished memory or a significant dream. The target gains one level of exhaustion and loses one of its highest-level spell slots (if any).

additionalAbilities.name: Arcane Combatant
additionalAbilities.description: The Trainee Auditor blends magical prowess with physical combat. Their melee attacks deal additional arcane damage, and they can cast limited spells while wielding weapons.

additionalAbilities.name: Audit of Weakness
additionalAbilities.description: Once per turn, the Auditor can analyze a target’s vulnerabilities. If the Auditor successfully lands a melee attack, the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on saving throws for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Trainee Auditor makes two attacks: one with their **Arcane Blade** and one with their **Mana Strike**, or two shots with their **Magitech Rifle.**

actions.name: Arcane Blade
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) arcane damage.

actions.name: Magitech Rifle
actions.description:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range80/200, one target. 
Hit: 10 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) a force damage.

actions.name: Mana Strike
actions.description: The Auditor channels raw arcane energy into their weapon, dealing 12 (3d8) force damage to a target within 30 ft. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone as the arcane energy detonates.

flavor.description: Medium elemental abomination, a shadowy presence that instills fear with its eerie, whispering darkness

additionalAbilities.name: Eerie Brown Note
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature within 25 ft. that witnesses the Darkling-Nightshade Elemental channel its shadow energy must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or lose their reactions until the end of their next turn, overcome by overwhelming dread.

actions.name: Shadow Swipe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+2 necrotic damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactician
additionalAbilities.description: When in groups of more than 2, darklings will attempt to gang up on singular opponents and close distances with long ranged attackers. This Darkling, with its superior intellect, uses its reaction to wordlessly give telepathic orders to any Darkling or Darkforme Overwatch it can see within 100 ft. If the Darkling follows this command, they receive a +1 bonus to the action.

flavor.description: A colossal blackened mass of bone and sinew, missing its legs and lashed together with inky black ooze. Voravenor rises from a massive bottomless bone pit of darkling biomass, its massive ventral maw gaping hungrily. Its two baleful eyes maintain a Shroud of Black Dread, which must be dispelled by blinding or destroying them to reveal its vulnerability to radiant light.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
damageImmunities: Radiant (while Shroud of Black Dread is active)
stats.legendaryActionsDescription: Voravenor: Hungore-Absolutor can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Voravenor: Hungore-Absolutor regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Shroud of Black Dread
additionalAbilities.description: Voravenor is wreathed in an aura of pure dread that makes it immune to radiant damage. This shroud is maintained by its two baleful eyes. The shroud is dispelled for 1 minute if Voravenor is blinded or if both of its eyes are destroyed, causing it to become vulnerable to radiant damage. Voravenor's eyes can be targeted separately (AC 18, 15 HP). An eye is destroyed if it takes 15 or more damage, more than 10 magical piercing damage in a single hit, or is targeted by a spell that deals radiant damage (which blinds it for 1 round).

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If Voravenor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

additionalAbilities.name: Siege Monster
additionalAbilities.description: Voravenor deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Swallow Hole (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description:
Voravenor opens its ventral maw and attempts to pull in all creatures in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pulled 20 feet toward Voravenor. Any creature that ends this movement within 5 feet of Voravenor is grappled (escape DC 19). Voravenor can use its bonus action to attempt to swallow one creature it is grappling. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Voravenor, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of Voravenor's turns.

If Voravenor takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Voravenor must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of Voravenor. If Voravenor dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

flavor.description: A crown‑bound juggernaut of shadow and bone, the Sire Reaver is the perfected warform of the Darkling‑Ossuite line — a predator‑warlord whose very advance unravels ranks. His every stride is a storm of iron hooves and soul‑rending will, and the fall of the Crown of Tyranny marks the moment the battle turns desperate for all who stand before him.

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If the Reaver fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Disabled while crown is destroyed.

It is fragile, but its song knits its bones back together as fast as they are shattered, unless purified by light or fire.

flavor.description:
Faction: The Gavel (Administrative Guard)
Role: Discipline and containment. Prefects are tasked with "detaining" unruly students and suppressing magical outbursts.

additionalAbilities.name: Darkforme Essence
additionalAbilities.description: Vulnerable to Radiant damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Aura of Discipline
additionalAbilities.description: Any hostile creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the Prefect must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened until the start of its next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Magic Resistance
additionalAbilities.description: The Prefect has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Gavel of Law
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) force damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage. If the target is an Academy student, they must make a DC 14 Constitution save (Potty Check) due to the psychic shock.

actions.name: Detention (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Prefect points their staff at a creature. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom save or be affected by the Hold Person spell for 1 minute.

actions.name: Strict Silence (1/Day)
actions.description: The Prefect slams their staff. A 30-foot radius sphere centered on the Prefect becomes a zone of absolute silence for 1 minute. No sound can be created within or pass through this area.

flavor.description:
Faction: The Swift-Strider Scouts
Role: Light melee infantry used for flanking and harassing spellcasters. They are high-mobility units designed to bypass the frontline.

additionalAbilities.name: Darkforme Essence
additionalAbilities.description: Vulnerable to Radiant damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Cunning Action
additionalAbilities.description: On each of its turns, the Skirmisher can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

additionalAbilities.name: Skirmish Attack
additionalAbilities.description: Once per turn, the Skirmisher deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a melee attack if the Skirmisher has moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target on the same turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Skirmisher makes two Shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

flavor.description:
Faction: The Cloud-Watcher Legion
Role: Flighted infantry utilized for aerial reconnaissance and dropping psychological payloads. Their wings are made of solidified shadow-mist.

additionalAbilities.name: Darkforme Essence
additionalAbilities.description: Vulnerable to Radiant damage. While in bright light or if hit by Radiant damage, its fly speed is halved.

additionalAbilities.name: Flyby
additionalAbilities.description: The Harrier doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Shadow Talon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Terror Screech (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The Harrier emits a piercing, otherworldly wail. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom save or be Frightened until the end of the Harrier's next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Darkforme Essence
additionalAbilities.description: Vulnerable to Radiant damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Steady Aim
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Ballisteer can plant its feet. Until the end of its turn, its speed is 0, but it has advantage on ranged attack rolls and ignores half and three-quarters cover.

additionalAbilities.name: Sniper's Nest
additionalAbilities.description: If the Ballisteer is at least 20 feet above its target, it deals an extra 3 (1d6) piercing damage on a hit.

actions.name: Heavy Siege Arbalest
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Pinning Bolt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Ballisteer fires a specialized heavy bolt. Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is restrained (escape DC 14) as the bolt pins it to the ground or a nearby wall.

flavor.description: Location: Zone A: The Foyer of Echoes

additionalAbilities.name: Unmoving Guard
additionalAbilities.description: Cannot be moved, knocked prone, or teleported against its will.

additionalAbilities.name: Echoes of the Foyer
additionalAbilities.description: While inside the Summer House, Krell deals an additional 9 (2d8) psychic damage on all attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Makes three Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Grave-Steel Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Gatekeeper's Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Targets up to 3 creatures within 30 ft. DC 15 WIS save or be Frightened. While Frightened, speed is 0.

flavor.description:
Faction: The Iron-Root Sappers (Light Support)
Role: Mid-range support units that fire alchemical and psychic canisters. They provide cover for the Enforcers.

additionalAbilities.name: Darkforme Essence
additionalAbilities.description: Vulnerable to Radiant damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Quick Loader
additionalAbilities.description: The Slinger can use a bonus action to swap between ammunition types.

actions.name: Heavy Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Alchemical Canister (3/Day)
actions.description: The Slinger hurls a specialized jar. Choose one: Psychic Smoke (Creates a 10-foot-radius sphere of gray fog. Creatures in the fog have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and Potty Checks) OR Sticky Resin (The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be restrained (escape DC 13) by hardening sap).

flavor.description: Location: Zone D: The War Room

additionalAbilities.name: Tactical Superiority
additionalAbilities.description: Darkforme allies within 60 ft have advantage on attack rolls if Rictus can see the target.

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If Rictus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Make up to three attacks with his Commander's Blade, or Issue an Iron Command and make 2 Attacks.

actions.name: Commander's Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Iron Command (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Rictus targets up to four allies. They immediately move their full speed and make one melee attack.

flavor.description: Location: Zone B: The Mess Hall

additionalAbilities.name: Scavenger's Hunger
additionalAbilities.description: Regains 10 HP if it starts its turn within 5 ft of a downed creature or a ration pile.

additionalAbilities.name: Berserk Frenzy
additionalAbilities.description: If below half HP, Gnash makes one additional attack as a bonus action but all attacks against him are at advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Cleaver attacks and one Bite.

actions.name: Rusting Cleaver
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is wearing metal armor, it takes a permanent -1 penalty to AC (stacks to -5).

actions.name: Corrupted Ration Bomb (3/Day)
actions.description: Throws a bag of rotting magical food. 20 ft radius. DC 14 CON save or take 21 (6d6) poison damage and be Poisoned.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning. Target is grappled (DC 14). While grappled, the target is Restrained and takes 11 (2d6 + 4) damage at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Drowning Squeeze
actions.description: The Suffocator forces a DC 14 Constitution Save (Potty Check). On a failure, the target loses 1 use charge of their diaper (or suffers a Wetting Accident) due to the crushing pressure.

additionalAbilities.name: Hierarchical Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The Scrapper has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if it is fighting alongside a higher CR ally (such as an Ossokin Bonesinger) that is within 5 feet of the target and not incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Brittle Swarm
additionalAbilities.description: If the Scrapper takes bludgeoning damage, it is knocked prone as its bones temporarily clatter out of alignment.

actions.name: Rusted Shiv
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ankle Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or larger creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn as the Ossokin clings to its leg.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Vora the Soul-Squeezer can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The vora the soul-squeezer regains spent legendary actions at the start of a new encounter

additionalAbilities.name: Dual Consciousness
additionalAbilities.description: Vora has two heads. The main head is immune to the Charmed and Unconscious (Sleep) conditions. The secondary head is vulnerable to these conditions. If the secondary head is Charmed by an enemy, roll a d10 at the start of each of Vora's turns. On a 10, the secondary head uses its magic against the main head.

additionalAbilities.name: Watery Transposition
additionalAbilities.description: While in shallow or deep water, Vora can use a bonus action to teleport up to 60 feet to another unoccupied space containing water.

additionalAbilities.name: Crushing Humiliation
additionalAbilities.description: A creature grappled by Vora must make a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw (Potty Check) at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Vora makes three attacks: one with her main Bite, one with her Constrict, and the secondary head uses one of its Magic options.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. Target is grappled (escape DC 18) and restrained.

actions.name: Churn (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Vora thrashes violently. A 15-foot radius (30-foot wide circle) area centered on Vora becomes deep, churning water until the end of her next turn. Any creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled into the center, taking 21 (6d6) crushing damage and beginning to drown.

actions.name: Secondary Head Magic (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description:
The dreaming head unleashes one of the following:
• Fireball: 20-ft sphere (8d6 fire, DC 15 Dex half).
• Glacial Surge: 60-ft line (31 (7d8) cold, DC 15 Str save or restrained).
• Aetheric Force Ray: One target within 90 ft. Hit: 44 (8d10) force damage.

legendaryActions.name: Legendary Resistance
legendaryActions.description: When Vora the Soul-Squeezer fails a check, she can instead choose to pass.

additionalAbilities.name: Resonant Fragility
additionalAbilities.description: If Sissel takes any Thunder (Sonic) damage, her crystals shatter. She loses her Radiant resistance for 1d4 turns or until she devours crystal, upon which the resistance returns immediately.

additionalAbilities.name: Echo-Crystal Constriction
additionalAbilities.description: Sissel’s constriction deals an additional 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Hypnotic Shimmer
additionalAbilities.description: Sissel can cast Mirror Image as a bonus action (2/encounter).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sissel makes two Bite attacks or one Bite and one Constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage. Target is grappled (escape DC 16).

damageResistances: piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning from non-magical attacks
stats.legendaryActionsDescription: Krazis the Corrupted can enter Full Steam mode when he reaches 100HP or lower. Upon entering Full Steam Mode, Krazzis cannot end the mode until

additionalAbilities.name: Old War Pollution
additionalAbilities.description: Area within 10 feet is lightly obscured by oily smoke. Creatures starting their turn there must make a DC 14 Constitution save or be Poisoned.

additionalAbilities.name: Corrosive Magitek Slime
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that hits Krazis with a melee attack within 5 feet takes 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Multi-Attack
actions.description: Krazis can make two bite attacks per turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Toxic Regurgitation (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Krazis exhales a 20-foot cone of alchemical sludge. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 28 (8d6) acid damage and their diaper/clothing is instantly rendered Saturated (0 Use Charges remaining).

legendaryActions.name: Full Steam Mode
legendaryActions.description: Krazis' movement speed is doubled, and any foe that hits Krazis with a melee attack also must roll a DC 13 Dexterity save or suffer an additional 1d6 fire damage.

flavor.description: Small, hyper-active simians partially cured of Darkling rot. Mischievous but useful.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Resurgence
additionalAbilities.description: If the cackler starts its turn in total darkness, it regains 2 hit points. If the cackler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The cackler has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Nimble Escape
additionalAbilities.description: The cackler can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Berry Flick
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a student, they must succeed on a DC 8 Charisma saving throw or lose 1 point from their Maturity Meter.

reactions.name: Helpful Mockery
reactions.description: When an ally within 30 feet is attacked, the cackler lets out a sharp, distracting giggle. The attacker must subtract 1d4 from their attack roll.

flavor.description: The standard nuisance of the woods, known for hurling sticky Glut-Pellets.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Resurgence
additionalAbilities.description: If the cackler starts its turn in total darkness, it regains 5 hit points. If the cackler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The cackler has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Canopy Ambush
additionalAbilities.description: The cackler has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in foliage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Glut-Pellet Toss
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be Restrained. A student restrained this way must make a DC 12 Potty Check.

flavor.description: A horrifying monstrosity with a vertical maw where its face should be.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Resurgence
additionalAbilities.description: If the cackler starts its turn in total darkness, it regains 5 hit points.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The cackler has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Scent of Regression
additionalAbilities.description: The cackler has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to track any creature with a Maturity Meter below 15.

actions.name: Vacuum Snap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. Target Medium or smaller is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Gnaw (While Grappling)
actions.description: The target takes 14 (4d6) slashing damage and must make a DC 14 Potty Check. On a failure, the target loses 2 points from their Maturity Meter.

flavor.description: The silver-backed king of the Dark simians. Coordaintes swarms with terrifying precision.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Resurgence
additionalAbilities.description: Regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn in darkness.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactician
additionalAbilities.description: While the Noxback is not incapacitated, any Cackler or Darkling ally within 30 feet gains Pack Tactics. If an ally with Pack Tactics hits with advantage in this aura, they deal an extra 1d6 damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Brute Force
additionalAbilities.description: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the noxback hits with it (included in attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Noxback makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or be knocked Prone.

actions.name: Primal Hoot (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Resonant mind-warping cry. Each enemy within 30 ft. must make a DC 14 Wisdom save. On failure, target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, is Frightened for 1 minute, and suffers Instant Saturation (Critical Potty Failure).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hactor makes two Kick attacks.

actions.name: Kick
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. DC 18 Strength save or pushed 15 feet.

actions.name: Thundering Thump (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Ground pound. 20-ft radius. DC 17 Constitution save or take 27 (6d8) thunder damage and be Stunned.

actions.name: Imperial Squish
actions.description: Leap up to 60 feet. Every creature in the landing space must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On failure: 45 (6d12 + 6) bludgeoning and Restrained. On success: half damage and pushed aside.

actions.name: Sleepy Exhalation (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: 60-foot cone. DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

legendaryActions.name: Bunnarch’s Twitch
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or be charmed by his cuteness until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Dreaming Kick (2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit: 34 (4d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage and knocked back 30 feet.

creatures.name: Lord Furuzzle: Bunnarch of All Bunkind

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Blanz-Coh makes three Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 7) piercing plus 21 (6d6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Red Streak (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Moves full speed through creature spaces. DC 19 Dexterity save or take 35 (10d6) slashing damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Keen Smell
additionalAbilities.description: The Gutroar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. It can smell food (or a poorly secured campsite) from up to 3 miles away.

additionalAbilities.name: Mammoth Bulk
additionalAbilities.description: The Gutroar counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift. It also has advantage on Strength saving throws against being knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Gutroar makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Roar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Gutroar lets out a deafening, unnatural bellow. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened until the end of the Gutroar's next turn. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, they must also immediately make a DC 10 Potty Check.

additionalAbilities.name: Follower of the Swoley Bible
additionalAbilities.description: The Suppsipper believes it is incredibly muscular. It has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to grapple, even against targets larger than itself. It constantly huffs and grunts as a free action.

additionalAbilities.name: Gainz-Bro Cry
additionalAbilities.description: When the Suppsipper scores a critical hit, reduces an enemy to 0 HP, or sees an enemy use the Dash action to move away from it, it lets out a triumphant, flexing roar. Roll a d4. On a 4, 1d3 standard Darkling Cublings arrive at the edge of the battlefield at the start of the next round, drawn by the call of 'the pump'.

actions.name: Protein Punch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. (The Suppsipper flexes excessively after each strike).

actions.name: Form-Check Shove
actions.description: The Suppsipper targets one creature it can see within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone as the Suppsipper aggressively critiques their stance.

damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
stats.legendaryActionsDescription: Grizzwauler can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Grizzwauler regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If Grizzwauler fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

additionalAbilities.name: Soot-Sense (Tri-Maw Belch)
additionalAbilities.description: The two extra mouths on Grizzwauler's torso constantly belch thick, black magical soot. The area within 15 feet of Grizzwauler is lightly obscured. Grizzwauler can perfectly sense any creature within this soot (granting it Blindsight 30 ft.), even if they are invisible.

additionalAbilities.name: Bad News Bears
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, Grizzwauler lets out a resonant, low-frequency roar. It summons 1d4 Darkling Cubling Suppsippers, which appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of Grizzwauler. It can use this ability once per day.

additionalAbilities.name: Protein Harvest
additionalAbilities.description: If a Darkling Cubling Suppsipper is within 5 feet of Grizzwauler, Grizzwauler can use a bonus action to instantly consume it. Grizzwauler regains 1d6+1 hit points, and the Suppsipper is destroyed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Grizzwauler makes three attacks: one with its primary Bite, and two with its Claws.

actions.name: Primary Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Torso Maws (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Grizzwauler forces a creature Grappled by it into its twin torso mouths. The creature must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 33 (6d10) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) necrotic damage from the soot. On a success, the creature takes half damage and escapes the grapple.

legendaryActions.name: Resistive Hide (1 Action)
legendaryActions.description: Grizzwauler flexes its massive, swollen hide. Until the start of its next turn, it gains resistance to one damage type of its choice (e.g., Fire, Cold, Lightning).

legendaryActions.name: Soot Cloud (2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Grizzwauler violently expels soot from its torso maws. Every creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be Blinded until the end of their next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Snack Time (1 Action)
legendaryActions.description: Grizzwauler uses its Protein Harvest ability on a nearby Suppsipper.

damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
additionalAbilities.description: The Pseudomaiden can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

additionalAbilities.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
additionalAbilities.description: The Pseudomaiden deals an extra 10 (3d6) necrotic damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally that isn't incapacitated and the Pseudomaiden doesn't have disadvantage.

actions.name: Inky Hair Lash
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Traumatizing Visage
actions.description: Each non-undead creature within 30 ft. that can see the Pseudomaiden's dripping, hollow eyes must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

additionalAbilities.name: Spider Climb
additionalAbilities.description: The tickle monster can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tickle monster makes two attacks: one with its Mean Hook and one with its Tickling Fingers.

actions.name: Mean Hook
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tickling Fingers
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target takes 4 (1d4 + 2) psychic damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone in fits of laughter, becoming Incapacitated until the end of its next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, they must immediately make a DC 10 Potty Check.

additionalAbilities.name: Targetable Digits
additionalAbilities.description:
Tittalus is a massive, floating hand with 5 distinct digits. Attackers can explicitly target a specific finger (AC 16). Each finger has exactly 30 Hit Points. Damage dealt to a finger damages Tittalus's total HP pool. When a finger drops to 0 HP, it is destroyed, and its associated ability is lost. If Tittalus reaches 0 HP, all remaining fingers are destroyed.
• Thumb: Enables Crushing Grip.
• Index: Enables Arcane Pointer (Spellcasting).
• Middle: Enables Worse Flick.
• Ring: Enables Heavy Punch.
• Pinky: Enables Tickle Wave.

additionalAbilities.name: Innate Spellcasting (Index Finger)
additionalAbilities.description: Tittalus can cast Mage Hand and Minor Illusion at will, and Hold Person and Magic Missile (3rd level) 3/day each.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tittalus uses three available attacks/actions depending on its remaining intact fingers.

actions.name: Heavy Punch (Requires Ring Finger)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Worse Flick (Requires Middle Finger)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The target must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are pushed 15 feet away and knocked prone. If pushed into a solid object or another creature, both take an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tickle Wave (Requires Pinky Finger)
actions.description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are incapacitated with laughter until the end of their next turn and must immediately make a DC 15 Potty Check.

actions.name: Crushing Grip (Requires Thumb)
actions.description: Bonus Action: Tittalus attempts to grapple a target within 5 feet.

damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Spectral Prankster
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Toddlegeist can magically turn Invisible and Incorporeal (able to move through objects and creatures as difficult terrain) simultaneously. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. The Toddlegeist loses both of these states instantly if any creature takes damage from its attacks or pranks, causing it to burst into uncontrollable peels of laughter.

additionalAbilities.name: Mirthful Summoning
additionalAbilities.description: When the Toddlegeist becomes visible due to a creature taking damage from its prank, its echoing laughter alters reality. Roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, it summons 1d3 Lost Plushies or 1 Ghostiby to unoccupied spaces within 30 feet.

actions.name: Hazardous Prank
actions.description: The Toddlegeist targets one creature it can see within 30 feet, causing a poltergeist-style prank (shoving down stairs, dropping a heavy rock). The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, the target takes half damage and isn't knocked prone.

additionalAbilities.name: Phalanx Formation
additionalAbilities.description: The Vanguard has advantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws if at least one Caelistian ally is within 5 feet of it and isn't incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: TactiTush Elite Padding
additionalAbilities.description: The Vanguard wears military-grade padded protection under its armor, granting it advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Vanguard makes two attacks with its Magitek Broadsword.

actions.name: Magitek Broadsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

additionalAbilities.name: Sniper's Roost
additionalAbilities.description: If the Gunner hasn't moved this turn, its ranged weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Gunner makes two attacks with its Magitek Rifle.

actions.name: Magitek Rifle
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/240 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) force damage.

actions.name: Overcharge Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Gunner overcharges its rifle and fires a burst of raw mana. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

additionalAbilities.name: Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description: The Zealot is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared: Cantrip (at will): guidance, radiant lance, diapering 1st level (4 slots): healing word, sanctuary, bane 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, spiritual weapon 3rd level (2 slots): mass pacification, dispel magic

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Zealot casts Radiant Lance and makes one melee attack.

actions.name: Ceremonial Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
additionalAbilities.description: The Infiltrator deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the Infiltrator that isn't incapacitated and the Infiltrator doesn't have disadvantage.

additionalAbilities.name: StealthWear Panty-Cut Advantage
additionalAbilities.description: Wearing magically discreet protection, the Infiltrator has a permanent +5 bonus to Stealth checks (factored into its skills) and advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to avoid being seen.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Infiltrator makes two attacks with its Phase Daggers.

actions.name: Phase Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

reactions.name: Smoke Evasion
reactions.description: When the Infiltrator takes damage, it can use its reaction to drop a magitek smoke bomb. A 10-foot-radius sphere of smoke appears centered on the Infiltrator, heavily obscuring the area until the end of its next turn. The Infiltrator can immediately move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
